MAb806 bound to yeast displayed EGFR fragment 273-621. interactions.assay: surface plasmon resonance (SPR) · dissociation constant KD
interactions.note: The epitope-specific FabC225 affinity for binding to EGFR and the EGFR domain III was calculated from SPR binding curves. The KD was 2.3 ± 0.5 and 1.7 ± 0.6 nM for sEGFR and sEGFR-III, respectively. Involvement of some epitope residues was confirmed by mutational analysis. A double mutant Q408M/H409E shows a 150-fold reduction in FabC225 binding. Additional alteration of Q384A results in a KD≈1 µM. The antibody is able to compete the binding of EGFR to EGF, which agrees with the overlapping binding sites for the Fab and EGF on EGFR domain III.
